lines.x: European Union diplomats stated there are no plans to resume purchases of Russian gas or ease existing sanctions.
Eurozone inflation reached 4.0% in October, marking a three-year high.
The European Commission is coordinating with the International Energy Agency regarding potential G7 emergency crude stock releases aimed at mitigating high global energy prices.
A wave of bomb threats has forced emergency landings and security interventions for at least 15 passenger flights across several European countries, including France, Italy, and Belgium.
